title: Card

show_for.description: Seconds this card stays before the next one in its box.

when.description: Only show while this holds. Without data or entity it tests the card's own data.

above.description: Holds while the value is above this number.

below.description: Holds while the value is below this number.

equals.description: Holds while the value is exactly this, like "playing" or 0.

not.description: Holds while the value is anything but this.

$comment: Card types and what each reads: clock: The time. Needs no data.; date: The date.; weather: The weather icon and its name, from the weather topic.; caption: The weather's lines of words, from the weather topic.; text: Words: a title, a message and a detail, with an optional big number or bar. Bound to data, the message is the data's value.; value: One reading with its unit and a trend arrow.; temperature: A temperature with feels like, high and low; the icon follows the weather. Reads attributes apparent_temperature, high and low, or attributes.temperature when the value is a weather condition.; climate: Temperature, humidity and a 24-hour line. Reads attributes humidity and history.; gauge: A bar with coloured bands.; chart: A series as an area or bars. The value is a list of numbers, oldest or soonest first.; forecast: Hours, or days, each with a weather icon. The value is a list shaped like Home Assistant's weather.get_forecasts.; ticker: A scrolling line of items with their change. The value is a list.; list: Many readings on one card. The value is a list.; departures: Transit rows: route, destination and minutes. The value is a list.; sun: The next sunrise or sunset. Reads attributes next_rising and next_setting, as on sun.sun.; image: A picture sent earlier as an asset.; lights: Lights in their own colours. Use entities or an area with the Home Assistant integration, or data whose value is a list.; media: What a media player is playing: title, artist, progress. Reads attributes media_title, media_artist, media_duration, media_position and media_position_updated_at.; animation: A full-strip animation. Notifications only.

data.description: Read value, unit and attributes from this key in the pool.

entity.description: A Home Assistant entity. The integration keeps a data key of the same name filled in, so this reads like data.

value.description: Inline data: the reading, words, or a list.

unit.description: Shown after the value, as Home Assistant writes it.

attributes.description: Inline data: everything else the card reads, like high and low.

outline.description: This card's outline, over its screen's: a colour all round, { color, at } on one side like a shadow below, or none. On a notification it's used for its card and its takeover.

effects.description: This card's place in the weather, over its screen's: behind, or around so rain and snow land on its words. Only on the weather sky.

speed.description: How fast this card scrolls, in LEDs a second: a ticker, or any words too long for their space. 0 holds them still; without it a ticker runs at 18 and long words at 16.

text_message.description: The second line. Can use tokens like {elapsed_min} or {since_time}, which the display keeps current.

text_detail.description: A small third line, shown on the card in a box or the tray, not on a whole-strip takeover. Takes the same tokens as message.

text_images.description: Up to two pictures by id (sent once on pixelbar/all/asset/image/<id>), drawn left of the words, like team crests.

text_since.description: When it happened, as an ISO time. {since_time} and {elapsed_min} in message, detail and big.value count from it; in an automation, {{ now().isoformat() }}.

text_until.description: When it ends, as an ISO time. {until_time} and {remaining_min} count to it.

title.description: A title or the big first line.

detail.description: The small print: details, times, minimum and maximum.

value.description: The value or the big number.

label.description: The small label at the top.

icon.description: The icon, where it takes a colour.

up.description: Up: a rising change, a ticker's up arrow.

down.description: Down: a falling change, a ticker's down arrow.

name.description: Names in a list, a ticker's symbols, a board's destinations.

value_trend.description: An arrow beside the value: up or down.

value_detail.description: A small line under the value.

value_decimals.description: How many decimal places to show, 0 to 4.

gauge_min.description: The left end of the bar. 0 by default.

gauge_max.description: The right end of the bar.

label.description: A word shown while the value is in this band, like GOOD.

gauge_bands.description: Up to 8 coloured stretches of the bar, in order, each up to a value, with an optional word shown while the value is in it.

chart_style.description: area fills under the values, bars draws a bar per value, line is the line alone; add smooth to curve area or line. smooth as a style is the older way to say line with smooth. rain and snow are the nowcast styles.

chart_labels.description: Left, middle and right labels under the chart. NOW, then the time ahead, by default (a forecast); history charts send their own, oldest on the left.

chart_max.description: The top of the scale. Without it the chart fits its highest value.

chart_smooth.description: Curve the area or line through the values instead of straight segments. false by default.

forecast_period.description: hourly or daily, as weather.get_forecasts returns them.

forecast_count.description: How many to show, 1 to 12. As many as fit by default.

ticker_change_unit.description: What follows each change. % by default; an empty string shows a count.

ticker_detail.description: Small print under the scroll, like TODAY'S CHANGE.

departures_style.description: bullets: a coloured route badge per line. board: a dark departures board.

lights_entities.description: The entities to show, up to 16. The integration fills value from an area or this list.

animation_name.description: goal, fireworks, confetti, red_alert, countdown, live, raid, weather, flag, or any holiday theme.

animation_title.description: The words the animation shows, large.

animation_message.description: A second line, where the animation has room for one.

animation_detail.description: A small line, where the animation has room for one.

animation_images.description: Up to two pictures by id, like the team crests for a goal.

animation_cards.description: For weather: the cards to show after the sky.

animation_flag.description: For flag: canada (the default), usa, or a pride flag.

animation_flags.description: For pride: the flags to cycle.

temperature.description: The temperature, or the high for a day.

precipitation.description: How much rain, in the unit of the forecast.

label.description: A short name, like SHOP or BTC.

route.description: The route or line, like 7 or KW.

detail.description: A short note before the minutes, like 10 car or platform 2. Shown when there's room.

rgb_color.description: Its colour as [r, g, b], 0 to 255.

animation_icon.description: The tray's icon after it plays.

departures_every.description: Seconds a page of three rows shows before the next, when there are more than three. 6 by default.
